name: artifacts-beam
description: Publish local HTML to Artifacts Beam, create revocable share links anyone can open without an account, pull reviewer comments back into your chat, and iterate on the HTML. Sign in through your browser with a personal Microsoft, Google, or Apple account — nothing to copy or paste.

interface.shortDescription: Publish HTML and share it for review
interface.longDescription: Turn a local HTML file into a link your team can open and comment on — no deploy, no branch, no build. Share links are revocable and can carry an expiry or a passcode, and reviewers need no account, no install, and no sign-up. Comments come back into your chat so your agent can apply them and publish a new version. Re-publishing the same file versions it automatically.
capabilities: Publish local HTML and auto-version it on re-publish
Create revocable share links with optional expiry and passcode
Read reviewer comments and reply or resolve them
Apply review feedback to the HTML and publish a new version
Manage artifact privacy, tags, and versions
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $artifacts-beam to publish this HTML and give me a link my team can comment on.
